source_digest_basis.title: 解析器边界计算: 长度/索引字段驱动内存访问

source_digest_basis.title: 协议滥用节流阈值默认 0=fail-open (上游 opt-in 加固)
source_digest_basis.pattern: 协议滥用节流阈值默认 0=fail-open (上游 opt-in 加固)
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: glitch 计数 + thres&&门控的强制路径
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 量级驱动权判据: 默认配置 sink 零强制效果 + 每事件成本为协议固有处理 → 不得报 remote 级 DoS, 按防御规避内核/加固缺口口径 (CK-MAGNITUDE-OWNERSHIP)

source_digest_basis.title: 反序列化器尺寸字段无门: wire 字节解码的长度直接进入分配/写操作
source_digest_basis.pattern: 反序列化器尺寸字段无门: wire 字节解码的长度直接进入分配/写操作

source_digest_basis.title: Asynchronous task object destroyed before worker completion
source_digest_basis.pattern: An asynchronous worker retains access to an object that another thread can destroy or reset
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: task lifetime termination, release, or reset while worker execution may still be active
source_digest_basis.pitfall: A documented lifetime contract is counterevidence only if its preconditions are guaranteed and all callers obey them; inspect every API path and caller.

source_digest_basis.title: 管理面配置装载端点无界整读 (修复残留形态)
source_digest_basis.pattern: 同库其他端点已封顶而本端点未封顶 = 修复的不完全覆盖残留
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: 配置装载 handler 的 io.Copy/ReadAll 无 MaxBytesReader
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 端点级字节预算必须与功能面逐一对照, 不能以'同功能端点已封顶'推定

source_digest_basis.title: Go HTTP middleware buffers complete responses without a size budget
source_digest_basis.pattern: Response interception, logging, or template middleware buffers a complete response without a byte limit
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: HTTP response recorder or middleware response-body buffer
source_digest_basis.pitfall: A limit applied after accumulation does not bound peak memory; distinguish attacker-controlled growth from a hardening-only concern.

source_digest_basis.title: Go query parse failure fails open in a routing or authorization decision
source_digest_basis.pattern: A query parsing error is converted into a non-match or permissive result used by a routing or authorization gate
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: query parser error handling that feeds a route matcher or access decision
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Check malformed separators and escapes, partial parse results, and whether parse failure denies or accidentally permits the operation.

source_digest_basis.title: Failed Go service reload leaves a provisional listener running
source_digest_basis.pattern: A failed configuration reload leaves a newly started listener or goroutine active
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: listener/server/goroutine lifecycle cleanup on failed reload paths
source_digest_basis.pitfall: This is resource lifecycle cleanup, not use-after-free; trace every provisional start to rollback/shutdown.

source_digest_basis.title: Unsynchronized shared mutable state across Go goroutines
source_digest_basis.pattern: Concurrent goroutines access shared mutable state without a lock, atomic operation, or ownership handoff
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: shared maps, slices, caches, and lifecycle fields crossing goroutine boundaries
source_digest_basis.pitfall: The race detector only covers executed schedules; review all reads/writes and cancellation/close ordering.

source_digest_basis.title: 配置目录 env 缺失回退 CWD 相对路径 + 写点无 O_NOFOLLOW
source_digest_basis.pattern: 退化 env 几何 + 世界可写 CWD = 本地低权主体预置目录/symlink 链
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: AppConfigDir/AppDataDir 回退 './app'; MkdirAll+WriteFile 无原子替换无跟链防护
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 权限位 (0700/0600) 防不住既有 inode 跟链写与异主目录放行; --resume 读回构成完整写→读链

source_digest_basis.title: Untrusted trust material installed across a privilege boundary
source_digest_basis.pattern: An untrusted principal can supply or replace certificate material consumed by a more privileged trust-store update
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: system or application trust-store installation or update
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Establish actual platform, privileges, source ownership, and approval behavior; neither root execution, Linux, nor a missing interactive gate may be assumed.

source_digest_basis.title: CWE-918 Server-Side Request Forgery
source_digest_basis.pattern: 服务端请求伪造: 外部输入驱动请求目标
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: 外部 URL 请求构造点
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 请求目标白名单/协议限制

source_digest_basis.title: 反序列化输入面: 对象流反序列化受攻击者控制
source_digest_basis.pattern: 反序列化输入面: 对象流反序列化受攻击者控制
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 反序列化过滤 (ObjectInputFilter 类) 缺省不启用——『默认防护』声称必须核实启用点 | gadget 链判定按可达类路径枚举, 不得以单类推定

source_digest_basis.title: Java 形态内存安全: 越界索引与截断 cast
source_digest_basis.pattern: 枚举 ordinal 下标无界/数值窄化截断/文本构造器绕过校验门禁
source_digest_basis.pitfall: JVM 边界检查把后果限制为 AIOOBE/异常, 但截断 cast 的静默错值无告警——判级按实际后果而非 CWE 族; 结构校验门禁与文本构造器路径不一致即假设

source_digest_basis.title: 日志注入: 用户可控值进日志记录 (控制字符/伪造记录行/敏感头)
source_digest_basis.pattern: 用户可控值 (client_id/用户名/URL 参数) 写入日志无消毒; 访问日志记录敏感头 (Authorization/Cookie)
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: logger 调用点 + 用户可控参数; access log 头记录点
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 消毒修复常单点——同族其他日志调用点未消毒是 fix-variant 形态; access log 掩码默认空列表 = 无掩码

source_digest_basis.title: CWE-89 SQL Injection

source_digest_basis.pitfall: 参数化查询优先; 拼接时必须枚举注入原语

source_digest_basis.title: 空引用/越界解引用: 解析结果零长度元素未防御 (Java 形态 AIOOBE/NPE)
source_digest_basis.pattern: split 后索引未检查长度 (尾随分隔符形态); DOM getFirstChild 空引用; 列表 get(0) 空列表; LDAP 属性值 substring/charAt/parseLong 未校验
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: split/index 点; DOM 节点取值点; 外部数据属性解析点
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Java String.split 移除尾随空串的语义是 AIOOBE 高发形态; 异常逃逸 vs 捕获的分支方向核实

source_digest_basis.title: 信任代理判定 fail-open: 未配置可信地址时恒真 + 客户端自置信任头被采信
source_digest_basis.pattern: isProxyTrusted 类判定未配置白名单时恒 true; 客户端可自置的信任头 (X-Forwarded-Trusted-Proxy 类) 直接设 true
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: 代理信任判定点; 头驱动的证书/身份查找门禁点
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 门禁不消费平台可信判定的形态 (平台契约短路); 证书头门禁的关闭条件与平台层加固无法代偿

source_digest_basis.title: 时序窗口: TOCTOU 检查与消费跨事务分离 / 并发窗口 (竞态窗口+会话过期+重放)
source_digest_basis.pattern: 检查与撤销写入跨事务分离 (contains 检查→流结束才 put); 持久化旁路在 CAS 判定之外无条件执行; 单次使用语义的占位与消费时序窗口
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: 单次消费检查点; 撤销/持久化写入点; 锁获取与释放回调点
source_digest_basis.pitfall: contains 只读检查与 put 原子写的窗口是默认形态——占位写前移是修复方向; 存量对象不受新保护机制覆盖 (开关翻转场景)

source_digest_basis.title: 类型混淆: 不可信 claim 强转 (JSON 类型攻击者可控)
source_digest_basis.pattern: getOtherClaims 取值直接强转 String 无 instanceof; 验签前使用未验签 claim 字段
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 外层 catch 兜底只收敛为 400 不影响鉴权判定——按错误路径缺陷定位

source_digest_basis.title: 无界集合累积: 分页参数直通 skip/limit 无钳制 (java 形态)
source_digest_basis.pattern: HTTP 分页参数 (first/max) 直通 skip/limit 无上界钳制; skip-before-limit 顺序的放大杠杆; provider 侧全量物化在 limit 之前
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: skip/limit 流操作点; provider 全量遍历点
source_digest_basis.pitfall: first 是独立放大杠杆 (skip 施加于 limit 之前); 只钳 max 不钳 first 的常规缓解不完整; 默认请求 (max=10) 也强制全量遍历的形态

source_digest_basis.title: 撤销策略未生效: 多层 notBefore/撤销校验维度缺失
source_digest_basis.pattern: realm/client/user 三级 notBefore 校验不完整的调用点; 撤销策略验证修复后未覆盖的兄弟路径
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 同族调用点对比矩阵: 修复后带全维度 vs 未修复缺维度; 无生产调用者的缺陷形态按不可达处理

source_digest_basis.pattern: unsafe 块边界: 安全不变量在 unsafe 内的自证义务

source_digest_basis.title: FFI 边界契约双侧核实: unsafe extern 的指针/长度契约承重在调用侧 (C++ CheckedInt/UTF-8 门) — unsafe 块自证义务的载体是跨语言调用契约而非 rust 侧单边

source_digest_basis.pitfall: ARC-managed strong references normally prevent UAF; examine Unmanaged, unsafe pointers, bridging, and foreign callbacks. | Retain-count imbalance may cause leaks or premature release; distinguish the actual failure mode.

source_digest_basis.title: Out-of-bounds read through Swift unsafe buffer or imported C pointer
source_digest_basis.pattern: 边界外读取: 索引/长度越界访问
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: unsafe buffer subscript and pointer advanced(by:) | C functions reading beyond the supplied pointer/count contract
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Ordinary Collection subscripts are bounds checked; focus on unsafe APIs and FFI contracts. | Validate integer narrowing and element-count multiplication before constructing buffer views.

source_digest_basis.title: CWE-770 Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling
source_digest_basis.pattern: 资源分配无上限或无节流
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 上限/节流在累积点之前

source_digest_basis.title: Missing authorization on a Swift server route or privileged operation
source_digest_basis.pattern: 访问控制缺失
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: Vapor route handlers and middleware | database, filesystem, or administrative operations reachable from a request
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Swift access control and type visibility are not request authorization. | A route group or middleware declaration is not effective unless it dominates every alias and registration path.

source_digest_basis.title: Incorrect principal/resource authorization in a Swift server handler
source_digest_basis.pattern: 授权判定错误(对象/角色归属错配)
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: Vapor/NIO route handlers and service methods | resource read/write after a role, owner, or tenant comparison
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Authentication proves identity, not permission for the selected object or action. | Check middleware and service-layer policy consistency across aliases.

source_digest_basis.title: Swift server object lookup uses a request-controlled key without ownership scoping
source_digest_basis.pattern: 用户可控键绕过授权(越权)
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: Vapor route parameters and ORM/repository lookups | resource mutation/read after lookup by a request-controlled key
source_digest_basis.pitfall: UUIDs and opaque identifiers do not establish ownership. | Authorization must cover nested, batch, and alternate route lookups.

source_digest_basis.title: CWE-20 Improper Input Validation
source_digest_basis.pattern: 输入校验缺失或不足
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 输入校验与消费点同层

source_digest_basis.title: CWE-22 Path Traversal
source_digest_basis.pattern: 路径名未限制到受限目录: 穿越/跳目录
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: 文件路径构造与打开点
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 规范化/白名单/根约束三选一必须存在

source_digest_basis.title: 命令拼接执行: 变量进入命令字符串
source_digest_basis.pattern: 命令拼接执行: 变量进入命令字符串
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 引号嵌套层级与参数展开次序是判定核心——逐层展开核实 | env 覆盖形态: 攻击者已能写框架文件时的能力支配裁决 (默认文件覆盖 env)

source_digest_basis.title: CWE-94 Code Injection
source_digest_basis.pattern: 外部输入被当作代码生成/执行
source_digest_basis.pitfall: 动态代码入口即信任边界

source_digest_basis.title: Unquoted shell expansion changes argv through word splitting and globbing
source_digest_basis.pattern: An unquoted expansion is split into multiple arguments or pathname matches
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: command arguments populated by unquoted parameter expansion
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Inspect quote context, IFS, pathname expansion, arrays, and nested command substitutions; this differs from shell command-string injection.

source_digest_basis.title: Attacker-influenced PATH selects an unintended executable
source_digest_basis.pattern: A privileged script invokes a command through an inherited or attacker-influenced search path
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: bare command invocation, PATH modification, env-based lookup, or sourced executable
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Trace effective UID, environment sanitization, PATH order, writable directories, and absolute executable paths.

source_digest_basis.title: Predictable temporary path in a privileged shell workflow
source_digest_basis.pattern: A script creates or reuses a predictable path in a shared temporary directory
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: temporary path creation followed by redirection, chmod, copy, or privileged write
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Verify atomic creation, restrictive umask, ownership, symlink behavior, and whether the parent directory is attacker-writable.

source_digest_basis.title: Filesystem check-then-use race in a privileged shell workflow
source_digest_basis.pattern: A path is tested/stat'ed and later opened, renamed, removed, or executed
source_digest_basis.sink_hint: test/[[ -e ]]/stat followed by redirection, cp, mv, rm, chmod, or execution
source_digest_basis.pitfall: Check whether an attacker can replace a path component or symlink between check and use; quoting alone does not prevent races.
